%======================================================================
%  layout.tex — page geometry, headers, footers, spacing.
%  UNCHANGED from the original preamble. Do not edit casually:
%  the header/footer rules and the UNED logo placement are tuned.
%======================================================================

% ---------- Dedication environment ----------
\newenvironment{dedication}
  {%\clearpage           % we want a new page          %% I commented this
   \thispagestyle{empty}% no header and footer
   \vspace*{\stretch{1}}% some space at the top
   \itshape             % the text is in italics
   \raggedleft          % flush to the right margin
  }
  {\par % end the paragraph
   \vspace{\stretch{3}} % space at bottom is three times that at the top
   \clearpage           % finish off the page
  }

% ---------- Header / footer rules ----------
\renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0.4pt}% Line at the header invisible
\renewcommand{\footrulewidth}{0.4pt}% Line at the footer visible
%\renewcommand{\plainheadrulewidth}{0pt}

\newcommand{\unedlogo}{%
  \raisebox{-0.25\height}{\includegraphics[width=1.5em]{Images/LOGOUNEDDDD.png}}%
}

% 2. Create an invisible phantom with the exact height/depth of the logo
\newcommand{\footerstrut}{\vphantom{\unedlogo}}

\fancypagestyle{fancyhdr}{%
  \fancyhf{}%
  \fancyhead[CE]{\leftmark}
  \fancyhead[CO]{\rightmark}
  \fancyfoot[LE]{\thepage}
  \fancyfoot[RO]{\thepage}
  % \footerstrut ensures odd pages have the exact same height as even pages:
  \fancyfoot[LO]{\textsc{Héctor Zalama Alonso}\footerstrut}
  \fancyfoot[RE]{\textsc{Universidad Nacional de Educación a Distancia}\quad\unedlogo}
  \renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0.4pt}
  \renewcommand{\footrulewidth}{0.4pt}
}

\fancypagestyle{plain}{%
  \fancyhf{}%
  \fancyfoot[LE]{\thepage}
  \fancyfoot[RO]{\thepage}
  \fancyfoot[LO]{\textsc{Héctor Zalama Alonso}\footerstrut}
  \fancyfoot[RE]{\textsc{Universidad Nacional de Educación a Distancia}\quad\unedlogo}
  \renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0pt}
  \renewcommand{\footrulewidth}{0.4pt}
}

\setlength{\headheight}{16pt}   % silences the fancyhdr \headheight warning
\pagestyle{fancyhdr}

% Part pages carry no footer
\patchcmd{\part}{\thispagestyle{plain}}{\thispagestyle{empty}}{}{}

% ---------- Float placement ----------
%  The default \bottomfraction is 0.3: a full-width figure with its caption is
%  taller than that, so LaTeX refuses to put it at the bottom of a text page and
%  defers it instead.  These values let a tall float sit at the foot of a page
%  that still carries text, which is what the [!b] specifiers below rely on.
%  (Note that the ORDER of letters in [htbp] is ignored -- LaTeX always tries
%  top, then bottom, then a float page -- so preferring the bottom means giving
%  b alone.)
\renewcommand{\topfraction}{0.85}
\renewcommand{\bottomfraction}{0.80}
\renewcommand{\textfraction}{0.10}
\renewcommand{\floatpagefraction}{0.75}

% ---------- Paragraph spacing ----------
\setlength{\parskip}{0.68em}
%\setlength{\parskip}{1em} %añadir espaciado entre parrafos. "em" es una unidad como cm o pt.
\setlength{\parindent}{0em} %quitar identacion en todo

% ---------- Equation numbering ----------
\numberwithin{equation}{chapter}
%\numberwithin{equation}{section}
